stories.title: Megafoguete Starship, da SpaceX, faz primeiro voo orbital e lança satélites

en.title: SpaceX's Starship megacocket completes first orbital flight and launches satellites
en.summary: SpaceX launched its Starship vehicle on its first orbital flight, aiming to accelerate construction of satellite megaconstellations around Earth. NASA plans to use the vehicle in its effort to return humans to the Moon ahead of China.

stories.title: Aulão gratuito para o Enem tem 750 vagas em Ananindeua; veja como se inscrever

en.title: Free exam prep session for Enem has 750 spots in Ananindeua; see how to register
en.summary: The state education department is offering two free preparatory classes for Brazil's national education exam in Ananindeua on October 3 and 24, with 750 available spots allocated on a first-come, first-served basis.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pede a Fux suspensão de decisão de Dino que liberou publicações sobre Nossa Senhora

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro asks Fux to suspend Dino's decision that allowed publications about Our Lady
en.summary: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro requested that Supreme Court Justice Luiz Fux overturn a decision by Justice Flávio Dino that permitted online publications about Nossa Senhora Aparecida.

stories.title: Inmet emite alerta laranja de baixa umidade do ar para quase 40 cidades da Paraíba; confira lista

en.title: Inmet issues orange alert for low humidity in nearly 40 cities in Paraíba; see list
en.summary: Brazil's National Institute of Meteorology issued an orange alert for low air humidity affecting 36 municipalities in Paraíba state, with risks of forest fires and health issues.

stories.title: Flávio recorre a Fux contra decisão que liberou posts de N.S. Aparecida; Dino envia caso ao plenário

en.title: Flávio appeals to Fux against decision that allowed N.S. Aparecida posts; Dino sends case to plenary
en.summary: A Supreme Court justice has appealed a decision permitting publications about Nossa Senhora Aparecida to the court's president, while another justice refers the matter to the full court for a vote.

stories.title: Dino pede a Fachin sessão do plenário para julgar publicações sobre Nossa Senhora

en.title: Dino requests plenary session from Fachin to judge publications about Nossa Senhora
en.summary: Justice Dino requested a full court session to vote on whether to uphold his decision allowing publications about the law designating Nossa Senhora Aparecida as Brazil's patron saint.

stories.title: Folha e Farias Brito liberam simulado gratuito da Unicamp; veja como participar

en.title: Folha and Farias Brito release free Unicamp practice test; see how to participate
en.summary: A free online practice exam modeled on Unicamp's entrance test begins Monday and runs through Thursday, available to students preparing for major selection processes and the Enem.

stories.title: Salles desiste de candidatura ao Senado de São Paulo e apoia Derrite e André do Prado

en.title: Salles withdraws from São Paulo Senate candidacy and supports Derrite and André do Prado
en.summary: Federal deputy Ricardo Salles withdrew his Senate candidacy in São Paulo and announced support for candidates Guilherme Derrite and André do Prado, with backing from Governor Tarcísio de Freitas.

stories.title: Ricardo Salles desiste de candidatura ao Senado por São Paulo

en.title: Ricardo Salles withdraws candidacy for Senate in São Paulo
en.summary: Ricardo Salles has decided to withdraw from running for a Senate seat representing São Paulo.

stories.title: Dino derruba decisão de Mendonça que removeu posts sobre falso apoio de Flávio a ‘tirar padroeira’

en.title: Dino overturns Mendonça's decision that removed posts about false support from Flávio to 'remove patron saint'
en.summary: Justice Minister Dino reversed a previous ruling that had removed social media posts regarding a political support matter involving a religious figure.

stories.title: Flávio pede que Fux derrube decisão de Dino sobre posts de Nossa Senhora

en.title: Flávio asks Fux to overturn Dino's decision on Nossa Senhora posts
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign requested that Supreme Court Justice Luiz Fux suspend Justice Flávio Dino's ruling that permitted the spread of false posts about the candidate's alleged plans to remove Nossa Senhora Aparecida's status as Brazil's patroness.

stories.title: Maierovitch: 'Dino acerta ao levar caso de Nossa Senhora ao plenário'

en.title: Maierovitch: 'Dino is correct in bringing Nossa Senhora case to plenary'
en.summary: Legal expert Wálter Maierovitch stated that Justice Flávio Dino made the right decision by referring the matter concerning religious freedom and posts about Nossa Senhora Aparecida to the full Supreme Court.

stories.title: Grupo propõe sistema de proteção financeira contra catástrofes com participação estatal e do setor segurador

en.title: Group proposes financial protection system against disasters with state and insurance sector participation
en.summary: A working group coordinated by Brazil's insurance regulator has proposed creating a financial protection system combining government and private insurance sector involvement to address increasing climate-related disasters amid low insurance coverage rates.

stories.title: China e EUA acertam cortes de tarifas sobre US$ 60 bilhões em produtos

en.title: China and US agree on tariff cuts on US$ 60 billion in products
en.summary: China and the United States reached an agreement to reduce tariffs on US$ 60 billion in mutual imports, including American corn, cosmetics, and Chinese appliances and toys, through recommendations for more favorable tariff treatment.

stories.title: Flórida pede à Justiça que impeça OpenAI de desenvolver novos modelos em processo sobre danos a crianças

en.title: Florida asks court to prevent OpenAI from developing new models in lawsuit over harm to children
en.summary: Florida's attorney general requested a judge to halt OpenAI's development of new artificial intelligence models without external oversight as part of litigation claiming the company misrepresented ChatGPT's safety and harmed children.

stories.title: BioNTech fechará três unidades na Alemanha após não encontrar compradores

en.title: BioNTech will close three units in Germany after failing to find buyers
en.summary: German vaccine manufacturer BioNTech announced the closure of German facilities it could not sell as the company transitions away from pandemic-era production infrastructure, having reached workforce agreements on severance terms.

stories.title: PT vê melhora em 'filme' de Lula na Quaest, mas segundo turno segue preocupando

en.title: PT sees improvement in Lula's profile in Quaest poll, but runoff remains concerning
en.summary: President Lula's party observed gains in Quaest polling data, with the president rising two percentage points to 39% in the first round, though concerns persist regarding a potential second-round scenario.
